paper.title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition

result.summary: 本文提出残差学习框架以缓解深层神经网络训练困难的问题，将网络层重新表述为学习相对于输入的残差函数 [S1.p5]。在 ImageNet 上，作者评估了深度达 152 层的残差网络，其复杂度低于 VGG 网络 [abstract]，集成模型在测试集上取得 3.57% 的 top-5 错误率并赢得 ILSVRC 2015 分类任务第一名 [S1.p9]。在 CIFAR-10 上，作者还分析了 100 层和 1000 层以上的网络 [abstract]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：当网络能够开始收敛时，随着深度增加会出现退化问题——准确率饱和后迅速下降，且这种退化并非由过拟合引起，给适当深的模型增加更多层反而导致更高的训练误差 [S1.p3]。作者指出，深度对网络性能至关重要，但简单地堆叠更多层并不能轻易获得更好的网络 [S1.p2]。

evidence.quote: When deeper networks are able to start converging, a degradation problem has been exposed: with the network depth increasing, accuracy gets saturated (which might be unsurprising) and then degrades rapidly.
Unexpectedly, such degradation is not caused by overfitting, and adding more layers to a suitably deep model leads to higher training error
Driven by the significance of depth, a question arises: Is learning better networks as easy as stacking more layers?

method.text: 论文提出深度残差学习框架，让堆叠的非线性层拟合残差映射 F(x):=H(x)-x，而不是直接拟合目标映射 H(x)，原始映射被重新表述为 F(x)+x [S1.p5]。该表述通过恒等映射的捷径连接实现，捷径连接不引入额外参数或计算复杂度，整个网络仍可用 SGD 端到端训练 [S1.p6]。当输入输出维度不一致时，可用线性投影 W_s 匹配维度，但实验表明恒等映射足以解决退化问题且更经济 [S3.SS2.p3]。

evidence.quote: Instead of hoping each few stacked layers directly fit a desired underlying mapping, we explicitly let these layers fit a residual mapping.
The original mapping is recast into $\mathcal{F}(\mathbf{x})+\mathbf{x}$.
Identity shortcut connections add neither extra parameter nor computational complexity.
But we will show by experiments that the identity mapping is sufficient for addressing the degradation problem and is economical

experiments.text: 论文在 ImageNet 2012 分类数据集（1000 类，128 万训练图像，5 万验证图像，10 万测试图像）上评估方法，报告 top-1 和 top-5 错误率 [S4.SS1.p1]。在 CIFAR-10 数据集（5 万训练图像，1 万测试图像，10 类）上进行了更多研究，聚焦极深网络的行为 [S4.SS2.p1]。此外，还在 PASCAL VOC 2007/2012 和 MS COCO 上采用 Faster R-CNN 进行目标检测评估 [S4.SS3.p1]。

evidence.quote: We evaluate our method on the ImageNet 2012 classification dataset that consists of 1000 classes.
The models are trained on the 1.28 million training images, and evaluated on the 50k validation images.
We conducted more studies on the CIFAR-10 dataset, which consists of 50k training images and 10k testing images in 10 classes.
Table 8 and 8 show the object detection baseline results on PASCAL VOC 2007 and 2012 and COCO.

findings.text: 在 ImageNet 上，34 层普通网络比 18 层普通网络验证误差更高，且整个训练过程中训练误差都更高 [S4.SS1.p3]；而 34 层 ResNet 优于 18 层 ResNet（提升 2.8%），且相比对应的普通网络将 top-1 误差降低 3.5% [S4.SS1.p6][S4.SS1.p7]。50/101/152 层 ResNet 比 34 层网络准确率更高，未观察到退化问题 [S4.SS1.p15]。152 层 ResNet 单模型 top-5 验证误差为 4.49%，六模型集成在测试集上取得 3.57% top-5 误差，赢得 ILSVRC 2015 第一名 [S4.SS1.p16]。在 CIFAR-10 上，ResNet 克服了优化困难并随深度增加获得准确率提升，110 层网络达到 6.43% 错误率 [S4.SS2.p5][S4.SS2.p6]。1202 层网络训练误差低于 0.1%，但测试误差为 7.93%，差于 110 层网络 [S4.SS2.p8][S4.SS2.p9]。

evidence.quote: The results in Table 2 show that the deeper 34-layer plain net has higher validation error than the shallower 18-layer plain net.
First, the situation is reversed with residual learning – the 34-layer ResNet is better than the 18-layer ResNet (by 2.8%).
Second, compared to its plain counterpart, the 34-layer ResNet reduces the top-1 error by 3.5% (Table 2)
The 50/101/152-layer ResNets are more accurate than the 34-layer ones by considerable margins (Table 3 and 5).
Our 152-layer ResNet has a single-model top-5 validation error of 4.49%.
This leads to 3.57% top-5 error on the test set (Table 5). This entry won the 1st place in ILSVRC 2015.
our ResNets manage to overcome the optimization difficulty and demonstrate accuracy gains when the depth increases.
yet is among the state-of-the-art results (6.43%, Table 6).
this $10^{3}$ -layer network is able to achieve training error $<$ 0.1% (Fig. 6, right). Its test error is still fairly good (7.93%, Table 6).
The testing result of this 1202-layer network is worse than that of our 110-layer network, although both have similar training error.

limitations.text: 作者承认，1202 层网络在 CIFAR-10 上测试结果差于 110 层网络，认为这是因为过拟合，该网络对此小数据集可能不必要地大（19.4M）[S4.SS2.p9]。作者在本文中未使用 maxout/dropout，仅通过深而窄的架构施加正则化，并指出结合更强正则化可能改善结果，留待未来研究 [S4.SS2.p9]。此外，作者指出深层普通网络优化困难的原因尚待未来研究 [S4.SS1.p4]。

evidence.quote: The testing result of this 1202-layer network is worse than that of our 110-layer network, although both have similar training error.
We argue that this is because of overfitting. The 1202-layer network may be unnecessarily large (19.4M) for this small dataset.
But combining with stronger regularization may improve results, which we will study in the future.
The reason for such optimization difficulties will be studied in the future.
